TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
At Emotion–fact confusion, reach for Imagine Today’S Emotional Weather. Keep the lens here: You are the landscape experiencing weather, not the storm’s legal name.

GOAL
You are the landscape experiencing weather, not the storm’s legal name.

Imagine A Path Pressure gets first beat; Add Shelter is pivot. Finish Move Forcing; skip rechecking.

WIN SIGNAL

rituals.hook: At Sensory disconnection, reach for Remember The Future In Advance. Finish criterion: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.recognition_cue: At Sensory disconnection, reach for Remember The Future In Advance. Finish criterion: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.

rituals.challenge: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.immediate_need: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.game_move: Create Memory gets first beat; Include Time is pivot. Last decision: Look Backward.
rituals.unique_game_move: Create Memory gets first beat; Include Time is pivot. Last decision: Look Backward.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
At Sensory disconnection, reach for Remember The Future In Advance. Finish criterion: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.

GAME MOVE
Create Memory gets first beat; Include Time is pivot. Last decision: Look Backward.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Create Memory — Create a memory-like scene set just after completing the action.
2. Include Time — Include time, location, body posture, one sensory cue, along with what you did when difficulty appeared.
3. Look Backward — Look backward from that imagined completion to the first real movement and perform it now.

FINISH MOVE — Let Look Backward be enough.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Remember The Future In Advance is useful if: desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar. Keep evidence; leave at Look Backward.
rituals.formula_flow: Create Memory → Include Time → Look Backward

PAUSE
Keep future scenes realistic rather than using fantasy as avoidance.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE
rituals.name: INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE
rituals.hook: At Action avoidance, reach for Interview The Obstacle. Only this matters: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.recognition_cue: At Action avoidance, reach for Interview The Obstacle. Only this matters: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.goal: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.mission: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.challenge: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.immediate_need: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.game_move: Give Obstacle gets first beat; Make Step is pivot. Nothing follows Picture Negotiate here.
rituals.unique_game_move: Give Obstacle gets first beat; Make Step is pivot. Nothing follows Picture Negotiate here.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
At Action avoidance, reach for Interview The Obstacle. Only this matters: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

GAME MOVE
Give Obstacle gets first beat; Make Step is pivot. Nothing follows Picture Negotiate here.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Give Obstacle — Give the obstacle a character and ask three questions: What are you protecting?
2. Ask Fear — What do you fear will happen?
3. Make Step — What would make one step acceptable?
4. Picture Negotiate — Picture its answers, then negotiate a small action that protects the valid need without handing over total control.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Interview The Obstacle is useful if: resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored. Finish there, not beyond Picture Negotiate.
rituals.formula_flow: Give Obstacle → Ask Fear → Make Step → Picture Negotiate
rituals.safety:

Do not personify intrusive voices or experiences if that worsens symptoms.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Move The Rule Between Worlds puts Context neglect on pause. Keep the lens here: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.

GAME MOVE
One pass: State Rule through Compare Effects. Finish Keep Core; skip rechecking.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Keep Core, then return to your day.

Move The Rule Between Worlds is complete when a rule must survive context before it earns the word universal. Keep Core marks the boundary.

GOAL

rituals.hook: Give The Belief A Postcode puts Boundary confusion on pause. Stay with this: A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.

TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Give The Belief A Postcode puts Boundary confusion on pause. Stay with this: A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.

GAME MOVE
One pass: Name The Belief through Test Inside. Finish at Set Its True Place; move on.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name The Belief — Say the belief silently.
2. Imagine Four Limits — Think about when, where, with whom, and under what conditions it may be true.
3. Test Inside — Picture one real case where it fits.
4. Test Outside — Picture one real case where it does not fit.
5. Set Its True Place — Say a smaller, more accurate version of the belief.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Set Its True Place, then return to your day.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
If a rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life., Give The Belief A Postcode has landed. Exit after Set Its True Place.
rituals.formula_flow: Name The Belief → Imagine Four Limits → Test Inside → Test Outside → Set Its True Place

Do not use belief boundaries to minimise abuse, discrimination, medical facts, legal duties, or immediate danger.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
